summary: Records that, following RFC 9280, responsibility for the RFC Series moved from the RFC Editor to the RFC Series Working Group and the RFC Series Approval Board, and the IAB's role changed. It does this by deleting a sentence from Section 2.1 of RFC 2026 saying RFC publication is the direct responsibility of the RFC Editor. It is a Best Current Practice.

eli5.summary: This is a one-line fix to an old rulebook. The old line said one office was in charge of RFCs. Now other groups share that job, so the line was crossed out.

questions: who is responsible for the rfc series now
what did rfc 9282 change in rfc 2026
what does rfc 9280 change about the rfc editor
subtitle: One deleted sentence in RFC 2026 to match a change in who is responsible for the RFC Series.

tldr.problem: RFC 2026 says RFC publication is the direct responsibility of the RFC Editor under the general direction of the IAB, but RFC 9280 moved that responsibility elsewhere.
tldr.mechanism: RFC 9282 deletes that sentence from Section 2.1 of RFC 2026.
tldr.outcome: RFC 2026 no longer says the RFC Editor is directly responsible for RFC publication. Responsibility sits with the RFC Series Working Group and the RFC Series Approval Board, and the IAB's role is altered.

today: RFC 9282 is a Best Current Practice and the unit metadata lists no RFC that obsoletes or updates it. It updates RFC 2026 to follow RFC 9280.

sections.title: What RFC 9280 Changed
sections.content:
In RFC 9280, responsibility for the RFC Series moved to the RFC Series Working Group and the RFC Series Approval Board. It is no longer the responsibility of the RFC Editor, and the role of the IAB in the RFC Series is altered.

RFC 9282 exists because an older document still said otherwise.
sections.eli5: The people in charge of the RFC books changed. The old rulebook still named the previous boss.

sections.title: The Deleted Sentence
sections.content:
Accordingly, in Section 2.1 of RFC 2026, the sentence "RFC publication is the direct responsibility of the RFC Editor, under the general direction of the IAB" is deleted.

That is the only change the document makes. It states no replacement wording.
sections.eli5: One sentence is erased. Nothing new is written in its place.

sections.title: IANA and Security Considerations
sections.content: The document has no IANA actions. It also presents no security considerations, which fits a change that only removes a statement about who is responsible.
sections.eli5: Nothing needs to be updated in any list, and nothing about safety changes.

references.text: Bradner, S., "The Internet Standards Process -- Revision 3", BCP 9, RFC 2026, October 1996.
Saint-Andre, P., Ed., "RFC Editor Model (Version 3)", RFC 9280, June 2022.
